Choose a merchant to see their wares, location, and available trading details.

For help locating the outlying merchants, see [[World generation#Finding_NPCs|world generation and finding NPCs]].

Prices, quantities, and conditions are maintained on the merchant's own page. An item's base value is not a quoted shop price.

See [[:Category:Merchants#Trading_rules|shared trading rules]], [[Currency and trading]] for prices and selling restrictions, and [[Calmia Root]] for a gathering-based income source.
